title: Log regularity under invertible Kummer charts
statement: Let $(Z,N)\to(Y,M)$ be a morphism of locally Noetherian fine saturated log schemes [def-trf-fs-log-blowup, pqf-def-locnoeth], and suppose $(Y,M)$ is log regular in the stratum and dimension sense of that definition. Assume etale locally on source and target it has compatible charts $P\to M$, $Q\to N$ by fine saturated monoids and an injective homomorphism $h:P\to Q$ such that every $q\in Q$ has a positive multiple in $h(P)$. Assume $h^{\rm gp}$ is injective with finite cokernel annihilated by a positive integer invertible on the target neighbourhood, and that the comparison $Z\to Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[P]}\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[Q]$ in those neighbourhoods is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Here $\mathbf Z[S]$ has abelian basis $z^s$ and multiplication $z^sz^t=z^{s+t}$. Then $(Z,N)$ is log regular. Neither regularity of the underlying scheme $Z$ nor torsion-freeness of the cokernel is assumed or concluded.

source.place: Expose VI 1.8, printed p. 70, with the standard invertible Kummer etale charts of VI 2.2, printed p. 72; VI 2.3, printed p. 73, explicitly states log regularity of the source over a log regular target.

proof.text: Fix a geometric point $\bar z$ of $Z$, its image $\bar y$ in $Y$, and chart neighbourhoods as in the statement. All rings below refer to this choice. Set $A=\mathcal O^{\rm sh}_{Y,\bar y}$ with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$, and let $\alpha:P\to A$ be the target chart. It is Noetherian by [lem-sc-strict-henselization-noetherian]. Form $W=\operatorname{Spec}A\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[P]}\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[Q]$ and $Z_A=Z\times_Y\operatorname{Spec}A$. The fibre-product universal properties identify $Z_A\to W$ with the base change of the given etale comparison. The chosen geometric point lifts to $Z_A$ and has an image $\bar w$ in $W$. The affine fibre-product formula identifies $W=\operatorname{Spec}C$ for $C=A\otimes_{\mathbf Z[P]}\mathbf Z[Q]$. Let $\mathfrak q$ be the prime of $\bar w$ and $B=C_{\mathfrak q}$; its contraction in $A$ is $\mathfrak m$. Choose finite monoid generators $q_1,\ldots,q_s$ of $Q$. The monomials $1\otimes z^{q_i}$ generate $C$ over $A$ by expanding each monomial, so the finite-type and localization Noetherianity nodes make $B$ Noetherian.

source.place: VI 2.2--2.3, pp.72--73; affine base change and Noetherian permanence, Stacks Tags 01I4, 00FN, 06LJ.

proof.text: The strict local ring $B^{\rm sh}$ at $\bar w$ identifies canonically with $\mathcal O_{Z,\bar z}$. Indeed the strict-local-invariance theorem applies first to $Z_A\to Z$, the base change of the structural map of the strict localization of $Y$ (explicitly included in its statement). It also applies to $Z_A\to W$, the base change of the etale chart comparison: an etale map is in particular locally a filtered colimit consisting of one etale algebra. Thus their strict localizations at the chosen geometric points are isomorphic. These are functorial identifications over the chart schemes, so they preserve the image of every $Q$-monomial. This argument also applies to the initial etale chart neighbourhoods and therefore does not assume that the given charts were global.

source.place: VI 2.2, p.72: etale-local chart reduction; strict-local invariance of etale and strict-local structural base changes.

proof.text: Put $G=\alpha^{-1}(A^\times)$, $F=\{q\in Q:z^q\in B^\times\}$, $S=P_G/G^{\rm gp}$ and $T=Q_F/F^{\rm gp}$. Products in a local ring are units exactly when both factors are units, so $G,F$ are faces and $h^{-1}(F)=G$, since $A\to B$ is local. The face-sharpening node makes $S,T$ sharp fs with finite free group completions. The associated-chart stalk formula identifies $S$ with $\overline M_{\bar y}$ and $T$ with $\overline N_{\bar z}$ under Step 2; adjoining local units and then quotienting by them identifies precisely elements differing by $G^{\rm gp}$ or $F^{\rm gp}$. In particular the nonunit log ideal in $B^{\rm sh}$ is $JB^{\rm sh}$, where $J=(z^q:q\notin F)B$. Apply the sharp-chart and completed-chart theorems to the log regular target at $\bar y$. After their permitted replacement of the sharp chart, they give $a:S\to A$ and a presentation $\widehat A=k[[S]][[t_1,\ldots,t_d]]$ or $V[[S]][[t_1,\ldots,t_d]]/(\theta)$ with $\theta-p\in(S\setminus\{0\},t_1,\ldots,t_d)$. Here $V$ is a Cohen ring. The original chart $\alpha$ and $a$ induce the same characteristic. Their lifts in the integral log monoid differ by a unique unit: cancellation proves uniqueness, and multiplying proves these units define a character $\epsilon:P^{\rm gp}\to A^\times$ with $\alpha(r)=\epsilon(r)a(\bar r)$ for $r\in P_G$. This retains arbitrary chart units rather than assuming sharp original charts.

source.place: VI 1.1--1.2 and 1.6, pp.69--70; VI 2.3, p.73, reduction to sharp completed charts.

proof.text: Apply [lem-per-completed-invertible-kummer-monoid-extension] with its $R=P$, its $Q$ equal to our $Q$, and its local rings $A,B$ as above. The hypothesis on positive multiples is exactly its Kummer hypothesis, and its injective group map and finite cokernel are assumed in the item. The annihilating positive integer is invertible in $A$, because it is invertible on the target neighbourhood. Step 3 gives its sharp chart $a$, unit character $\epsilon$ and monomial-compatible completed presentation. It follows that, with this same $T$ and $J$, there are a nonzero complete regular Noetherian local ring $D$ and pair isomorphisms $(\widehat B,J\widehat B)\cong(H,L)$ in equal characteristic or $(H/(\eta),L(H/(\eta)))$ in mixed characteristic. Here $H=D[[T]]$ and $L$ is generated by the nonzero $T$-monomials; in the second case the reduction $\bar\eta\in D$ lies in $\mathfrak m_D\setminus\mathfrak m_D^2$. This is a ring-and-ideal normal form, not a citation of log-regularity preservation.

source.place: VI 2.3, p.73, the two completed local ring formulas, including the stratum ideal.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-formal-monoid-ring-dimension] to the complete regular coefficient ring $D$ and the sharp fs monoid $T$. In equal characteristic it gives $H/L\cong D$ and $\dim H=\dim D+\operatorname{rank}T^{\rm gp}$. In mixed characteristic its parameter clause gives that $D/(\bar\eta)$ is regular local and $\dim(H/(\eta))=\dim D+\operatorname{rank}T^{\rm gp}-1$, while $\dim(D/(\bar\eta))=\dim D-1$. Therefore in both cases $\widehat B/J\widehat B$ is regular and $\dim\widehat B=\dim(\widehat B/J\widehat B)+\operatorname{rank}T^{\rm gp}$.

source.place: VI 1.2 and 2.3, pp.69,73: stratum quotient and dimension calculation.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-local-completion-quotient] to $B\to B/J$. It identifies $\widehat B/J\widehat B$ with the completion of $B/J$. Both $B$ and $B/J$ are Noetherian local. Completion detects regularity and preserves dimension by the two cited completion nodes, so Step 5 yields regularity of $B/J$ and $\dim B=\dim(B/J)+\operatorname{rank}T^{\rm gp}$. Apply the closed-immersion strict-localization theorem to $\operatorname{Spec}(B/J)\to\operatorname{Spec}B$. It gives $B^{\rm sh}/JB^{\rm sh}\cong(B/J)^{\rm sh}$. Strict henselization preserves regularity and dimension by the cited nodes, so this quotient is regular and $\dim B^{\rm sh}=\dim(B^{\rm sh}/JB^{\rm sh})+\operatorname{rank}T^{\rm gp}$. Using the monomial-preserving identification in Step 2 and the characteristic and ideal calculation in Step 3, these are exactly the two defining conditions for log regularity of $(Z,N)$ at $\bar z$. Every geometric point has been treated. If $Z$ is empty, the pointwise condition is vacuous. No ordinary regularity of $Z$ or torsion-freeness of the chart cokernel has been used.

source.place: VI 1.2 and 2.3, pp.69,73; Stacks Tags 05WS, 06LN, 06LK and completion invariance.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q67-577bf0ff7 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read the item's 6 steps, the new node lem-per-completed-invertible-kummer-monoid-extension, every cited statement, and ILO VI 1.6–1.8 and 2.2–2.3 (PDF pp. 75–79). The item is unchanged and is VI 1.8 in the Kummer log-étale case that VI 2.2–2.3 describe, explicitly including 'Y log régulier, de sorte que X l'est également'. The split follows steps 4–7 of the existing lem-trf-log-smooth-log-regular. S1: noetherianity of A=O^sh and of B=C_q, finite type via the generators of Q. S2: 05WR invariance applied to Z_A→Z (base change of the structural map, explicitly covered) and to Z_A→W (étale); monomials preserved. S3: faces with h^{-1}F=G because A→B is local; the chart condition gives S≅M̄_ȳ, T≅N̄_z̄ and the log ideal J·B^sh; sharp and completed chart; ε checked by cancellation in the integral M_ȳ. S4: every hypothesis of the new node checked (N invertible on the neighbourhood, so in A). S5: formal-monoid-ring-dimension gives regularity and dim difference rk T^gp in both characteristics. S6: completion of the quotient, completion regularity and dimension, closed-immersion strict localization, strict-henselization regularity and dimension. The new node generalizes the trf extension model from an isomorphism on group completions to Kummer with invertible-order cokernel. It is not a duplicate and not a restatement of the item. Tested: A=Q[[s]] with twist −1 (absorbed, since only the ring and ideal pair are identified), unit R=Z with u not a square (étale, T=0), Z_p with y^m=p, and the excluded case Z/p in characteristic p. Advisory: 'complete' cites no adically-complete definition, the same omission as the trf model; no change made. No cycle (closure 631; the old log-smooth citation is gone). No SGA. Cross-unit tool_uses accepted. Batch 5: the closures of def-trf-fs-log-blowup, ind-etale-strict-local-invariance (05WR), fs-face-sharpening, log-regular-sharp-chart, log-regular-completed-chart, formal-monoid-ring-dimension and closed-immersion-strict-localization-cartesian (05WS) contain only general log-geometry and commutative-algebra trf nodes and no thm-trf, sk-thm-trace, nt-assume or Poincaré node. They are outside both assumptions, so accepted.

lean.statement: theorem invertibleKummerChart_logRegular (X Y : FineSaturatedLogScheme.{u}) (f : EtaleLogHom X Y) (hY : Y.IsLogRegular) (hcharts : ∀ x : X.scheme, ∃ c : FSLogChart f, x ∈ Set.range c.V.hom ∧ Function.Injective c.g ∧ Function.Injective c.groupMap ∧ Finite c.cokernel ∧ (∀ q : c.Q, ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∃ p : c.P, c.g p = q ^ n) ∧ (∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ (∀ z : c.cokernel, z ^ n = 1) ∧ (∀ y : c.W.left, IsUnit ((n : ℕ) : c.W.left.presheaf.stalk y))) ∧ Etale c.comparison) : X.IsLogRegular
